g.text: D1 is the red light in the middle of the sheriff's star: reverse-mount, shining through the board. 1.3 k gives about 1 mA.

g.desc: D1 is the red light in the middle of the sheriff's star: reverse-mount, shining through the board. 1.3 k gives about 1 mA.

g.text: The maker's board had a 5 mm through-hole LED there, a 1 k resistor, and a solder jumper 'LED SELECT' (badge VCC or badge GPIO2).

g.desc: The maker's board had a 5 mm through-hole LED there, a 1 k resistor, and a solder jumper 'LED SELECT' (badge VCC or badge GPIO2).

g.text: That jumper is gone: the switch chooses the supply, and GPIO2 is left unconnected.

g.desc: That jumper is gone: the switch chooses the supply, and GPIO2 is left unconnected.

g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LED. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LED. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.text: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).

g.desc: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).
